caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #119: OBSTREPEROUS

obstreperous (adjective): noisy and difficult to control.

✅ In a sentence: The obstreperous crowd drowned out the speaker.
✅ Similar: unruly, rowdy, boisterous
✅ Remember it: Latin strepere = to make a noise.
